reviews.text: Good first experience. Thanks Cindy
Yasar thank you for your review, it means a lot to us.
provides a great service and always does what we ask for

What a delightful experience, The two young ones were in safe hands and came back out smiling. Credit to this company and staff. Very friendly and welcoming atmosphere, All questions answered. Will 100% be back. Thank you again 🌟 …

Remarkable place

Person who carries out grooming
Our cavapoo has been going here for years and we love Cindy. She always does such a good job. 10/10 - would reccomend.

The owner is a lovely lady and very good at her job and remembers our cats names and little personal details about them which mades the whole experience lovely. We've used her services multiple times and it's been excellent each time without fail.

I was very lucky to find Pawcasso. Cindy has been professional and very good with my yorkiepoo. She is experienced, patient and attentive. Excellent service.....Thank you Cindy!

Andrew

This place is really great! My sister has a Persian x Maine Coon and brings him to Pawcasso on a regular basis with absolutely superb service. The lady working there is always very approachable, easy going and such a breath of fresh air to talk to. If I had a pet myself I'd probably only take them to Pawcasso and my sister has never had any issues with her cat.

We’ve been going to Pawcasso since 2021, and Cindy has been amazing with our cockapoo, Kara. She takes such good care of her—always gentle, patient, and loving. Kara’s haircuts are always spot on, and just the way we like them! Kara always leaves happy, and we feel lucky to have found someone we trust so much. Highly recommend!

Great customer service and fantastic grooming done on my long haired cat. Highly recommend to anyone.

Update: 1 year later and still getting amazing trims from Pawcasso. They put the comfort of animals first and my cat isn’t stressed out at all when back home.

Update 2: Another amazing trim, one happy cat.

Update 3: Evie always loves her time at Pawcasso, comes home very relaxed and looking very well trimmed. I always appreciate the work done by Cindy.
Friendly and professional.
Cindy did an amazing job. My rag doll cat had no matts and he was smelling really good too. I would recommend this place for anyone with cats in Glasgow. The best groomer !
Hi Jordan, thank you for your 5* review
Lokek, we really appreciate your 5* review
Really friendly and first class grooming as always.
Recently brought my Maine Coon cat for a full groom and was very happy with the friendly and professional service provided. Definitely bringing her back here again!
Thanks for your review

I have been taking my cat Coby here for over 10 years now and I absolutley love how he looks and smells after. It's hard to find a good place that does cats but I found it here. I'm always greeted with a lovely happy demeanor too, great customer service.
My persian goes here and always comes back like a new man.
